name: Gusto
description: Gusto is a payroll, benefits, and HR platform built for small and mid-sized U.S. businesses, combining automated payroll tax filing with benefits administration, hiring/onboarding tools, and a mobile app (Gusto Wallet) that gives employees early access to pay and budgeting tools.
best_for: Small and mid-sized U.S. businesses that want payroll, benefits, and core HR in one platform with published, predictable per-plan pricing.
features: Automated payroll runs with federal, state, and local tax calculation and filing
Health, dental, vision, life insurance, and 401(k) benefits administration
Hiring and onboarding tools including custom offer letters, checklists, and digital signatures
Time tracking that syncs directly with payroll
Gusto Wallet mobile app: paycheck splitting, savings goals, and on-demand/early pay access for employees
Gus, an in-app assistant employees and admins can ask payroll, benefits, time-tracking, and HR questions
Domestic and, on higher plans, global contractor payments
Compliance alerts and required-training tracking on higher-tier plans
pros: Publishes per-plan pricing (base fee plus per-person fee) rather than requiring a sales call for every quote
No long-term contract; billed month-to-month and cancellable anytime
New accounts are not charged until the first payroll is actually run
cons: Entry-level Simple plan excludes multi-state payroll, next-day direct deposit, and most HR tools, which require upgrading to Plus or Premium
Add-ons such as tax-advantaged benefits administration, priority support, and expedited payments carry separate charges on top of the base plan

tiers.name: Simple
tiers.notes: Plus $6/person/month. Single-state payroll, PTO tracking, and onboarding; excludes multi-state payroll and most HR tools.

tiers.name: Plus
tiers.notes: Plus $12/person/month. Adds time tracking, workforce cost reports, and expense/reimbursement management.

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.notes: Plus $22/person/month. Adds unlimited custom admin roles and compliance alerts; state tax registration and global contractor payments are add-ons.

alternatives.name: Rippling
alternatives.description: A modular workforce platform unifying HR, payroll, IT device management, and spend management on one employee record.
alternatives.best_for: Companies wanting to add IT and finance modules to HR/payroll rather than a payroll-first standalone tool.

alternatives.name: BambooHR
alternatives.description: A dedicated HRIS focused on core HR record-keeping, applicant tracking, and employee experience.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses wanting an HR-first system of record with payroll as an add-on rather than the primary product.

alternatives.name: Deel
alternatives.description: A global payroll and compliance platform for hiring and paying international contractors and employees.
alternatives.best_for: Companies whose primary need is compliant global/international payments rather than U.S.-focused SMB payroll.

alternatives.name: ADP Workforce Now
alternatives.description: A long-established HCM suite from ADP covering payroll, benefits, and HR for small to enterprise employers.
alternatives.best_for: Employers wanting a payroll provider with decades of tax-compliance infrastructure and broad company-size coverage.
